proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : n ≠ 1 := by
    by_contra h
    -- Assume n = 1 and derive a contradiction.
    have h₂ : n = 1 := by simpa using h
    have h₃ : ∑ i ∈ properUnitaryDivisors n, i = n := hn.1
    have h₄ : 0 < n := hn.2
    rw [h₂] at h₃
    -- For n = 1, properUnitaryDivisors 1 is empty.
    have h₅ : properUnitaryDivisors 1 = ∅ := by
      rfl
    rw [h₅] at h₃
    -- The sum of the empty set is 0, but n = 1, so 0 ≠ 1.
    norm_num at h₃
    <;> simp_all [Finset.sum_empty]
    <;> aesop
  
  have h₂ : 1 < n := by
    by_contra h
    -- If n ≤ 1, then n = 1 because n > 0.
    have h₃ : n ≤ 1 := by linarith
    have h₄ : n > 0 := hn.2
    have h₅ : n = 1 := by
      omega
    -- This contradicts h₁ : n ≠ 1.
    contradiction
  
  exact h₂
